purpose: Teach: 除雪/透過/発芽/絶縁/局所/鮮度/生鮮/基板

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、豪雪地帯の除雪体制の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on snow removal systems in heavy-snow regions, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Casual certainty — she's reviewing his work, not questioning him. Slight lift at the end, inviting confirmation without pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、可視光透過率の素材研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on light-transmission properties of materials.
lines.style: Quiet, straightforward delivery. A beat of hesitation — aware the answer doesn't quite match the question but committing to the truth anyway. Even pace, no defensiveness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、種子の発芽条件を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered seed germination conditions in your research, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly curious tone. She's listening closely now, noticing something off. Gentle probe, not accusatory. Pause before his name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、電線の絶縁体技術を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, my paper focused on wire insulation technology.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No apology in the voice, but a quiet awareness he's not answering what she asked. Maintains eye contact through discomfort.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 脳の局所機能解剖を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your work addressed localized brain anatomy, is that right?
lines.style: Sharper focus now. She's not asking anymore — she's confirming what she's noticed. Measured pace, direct but not unkind. Waiting for something to break.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、刺身の鮮度管理研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about freshness management in sashimi.
lines.style: Slightly defensive undertone creeping in. Same calm surface, but the strain shows in the steadiness — he's holding on. Breath controlled. No filler.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、生鮮食品の流通網を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper was on distribution networks for fresh food products, wasn't it?
lines.style: Calm but now clearly testing. She knows something is happening. Voice stays warm but with an edge of clarity — a teacher who sees through evasion. Pause on his name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、半導体基板の製造工程を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I did research on semiconductor manufacturing processes.
lines.style: Final answer. Breath held slightly at the start. Very quiet. The facade fractures barely — same words, same structure, but something true underneath finally. Trails off into resignation.
